---
title: "Contact"
# The search-engine description (Stage 6, fix 2, 13 November 2026). Quarto
# writes description-meta into the page's <meta name="description"> only;
# unlike description, it is not shown on the page.
description-meta: "How to contact Thomas Stubbs for commissioned research, advisory work, speaking, media, or academic enquiries: email, postal address, and research profiles."
---

```{r}
#| include: false
# The email address, postal address, department, and profile links come from
# data/site.yml, so each is edited in one place. Email, address, and profile
# links only: no telephone number and no form (decision 11).
site <- yaml::read_yaml("data/site.yml")
esc <- function(x) htmltools::htmlEscape(x)

# One labelled row: the label in a left column beside its content, as the
# year groups on the publication pages. Printed as a raw HTML block, so
# Pandoc leaves the addresses untouched.
contact_row <- function(label, html) {
  paste0('<div class="contact-row"><h2 class="contact-label">', label,
         '</h2><div class="contact-value">', html, "</div></div>")
}

email <- esc(site$contact$email)
rows <- c(
  contact_row("Email",
    paste0('<p><a href="mailto:', email, '">', email, "</a></p>")),
  contact_row("Address",
    paste0("<p>", paste(esc(c(site$department$name, site$contact$address)),
                        collapse = "<br>"), "</p>")),
  contact_row("Profiles",
    paste0('<ul class="contact-links">',
           paste0('<li><a href="', vapply(site$profiles, function(p) esc(p$url), ""),
                  '">', vapply(site$profiles, function(p) esc(p$name), ""), "</a></li>",
                  collapse = ""),
           "</ul>"))
)
```

For commissioned research, advisory work, speaking, media, or academic enquiries, please email me.

```{r}
#| output: asis
cat("\n```{=html}\n", '<div class="contact-list">', rows, "</div>", "\n```\n\n", sep = "\n")
```
